summary: Build a counter that accepts one call at a time. Each call brings a time t measured in milliseconds, and every later call uses a strictly larger t than the one before it. Each t is an integer from 1 through 1000000000, and one test issues at most 10000 calls. For a call at time t, count every earlier call whose time lies inside the closed window from t minus 3000 through t, including the call happening now. Write that count for each call.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
